verdict.rationale: The docs show OAuth client-credentials-grant authentication with short-lived tokens and 'more granular control over the scope of access' (docs-6, docs-14, docs-29), which supports least-privilege credential issuance in principle, but there is no agent-specific tooling, scope enumeration, or guidance for issuing/limiting credentials to an autonomous AI agent. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission model documentation, agent-specific credential issuance workflow, and independent corroboration of least-privilege enforcement.
